Function used to read through many patient files and concatenate into a dataframe
commented out output path option currently, may make an if statement if separate reusable .tsv files are needed later

```{r}
wrangle_data = function (path,pattern #, output_path
                         ) {
  files_list = list.files(path = path, pattern=pattern, recursive = TRUE, full.names=TRUE)

  results_file = map_dfr(files_list, function(x)
  {read_delim (x, delim = "\t", show_col_types = FALSE, na=c("NA", "", "n/a")) %>% 
    mutate(subject = str_extract(x, pattern = "sub-[^/\\\\_]+")) %>% 
    mutate(task = str_extract(x, pattern = "nback|rest")) %>%
    mutate (session = str_extract(x, pattern = "ses-0\\d")) %>%
    select(subject, task, session, everything())
  })
  #comment out filter if both rest and nback wanted
  #filter(results_file, task=="rest")
  #write_tsv(results_file, output_path)
}
```

function for global corr calculation:
```{r}
calculate_GC = function(dataframe, string){
  #timeseries datasets are in wide format, need to change format to long
  long_ts = dataframe %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(subject,task,session), names_to = "Node", values_to="Value")
  
  if(string == "individual"){
    group = long_ts %>% group_by(subject, task, session, Node)
  } else if (string =="group"){
    group = long_ts%>% group_by(Node) 
  } else{
    print("Please specify group or individual analysis")
  }

  calculate =  group %>% 
    summarise(
     mean_GC = mean(Value), 
      Pos_GC = mean(subset(Value, Value>0)),
      Abs_GC = mean(abs(Value))
      )
}
```

```{r}
#randomly select ten subjects and make brai nmap of it (will need ggseg)
ten_sub = sample(unique(ts_Glasser_rest$subject), 10)
GC_Glasser_rand_individual= calculate_GC(ts_Glasser_rest, "individual") %>% 
  filter(subject %in% ten_sub) %>%
  rename(label = Node) %>%    
  mutate(subject = as.factor(subject)) %>% 
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))

GC_Glasser_individual= calculate_GC(ts_Glasser_rest, "individual") %>% 
  filter(subject %in% ten_sub) %>%
  rename(label = Node) %>%    
  mutate(subject = as.factor(subject)) %>% 
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))
GC_Glasser_group = calculate_GC(ts_Glasser_rest, "group") %>% 
  rename(label = Node) %>%    
  mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Left", "lh_L") %>% 
           str_replace("Right", "rh_R"))
```

making individual brain map for Glasser for ten subjects
```{r}
#to note: glasser label doesn't have lh_L_10pp, so a tibble pops up that shows it's empty 
ggseg(.data = GC_Glasser_rand_individual,
      atlas = glasser,
      mapping = aes(fill=mean_GC)) +
  facet_wrap(~subject) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = paste("Mean GSCorr for Subject", ~subject))
```
```{r}
ggseg(.data = GC_Glasser_group,
      atlas = glasser,
      mapping = aes(fill=mean_GC)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = paste("Mean GSCorr for Group"))
```

```{r}
#global corr calculator
#hint given: to calculate - grad correlation matrix
#Total GC = mean of row
#Positive GC = mean of all positive values in the row
#Absolute GC = mean of absolute values in the row

#let's use an example file first with one patient, note this patient only has resting state
ts_practice = wrangle_data("/scratch/amiah/SCanD_project/data/local/derivatives/xcp_d/0.7.3/", "sub-CMH00000023_ses-03_task-rest_run-02_space-fsLR_seg-HCP_stat-mean_timeseries.tsv") 

#issue with this is that the parcellations are columns instead of rows - i'm assuming we are calcualting each parcellation instead of averaging each point in time for timeseries... what would you even analyze with each point in time...
#mean of each column, then in new file put each column as an item in a row? so that one row has subject, task, parcel, total GC, +GC, absolute GC

#change parcels so its all in one column
long_ts = ts_practice %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(subject,task,session), names_to = "Node", values_to="Value")

calculate = long_ts %>% group_by(subject,task,session, Node) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_GC = mean(Value), 
    Pos_GC = mean(subset(Value, Value>0)),
    Abs_GC = mean(abs(Value))
      )
```
